description: Look up a term in the Penny Press Lexicon (the author's own definitions of his political-economy vocabulary). Returns free metadata — part of speech and the essays where the term appears — plus payment info for the $0.01 full definition.

term.description: The term or its slug, e.g. 'fiat-order'

name: lexicon_lookup

appears_in.description: Essay slugs where the term is used
